This article is about Mythra's gameplay in this specific game. For information on the character in general, see Mythra.

Mythra is one of Rex's Blades in Xenoblade Chronicles 2. She reveals herself and becomes playable for the first time during the battle in Olethro Playhouse in Uraya during the second phase. She becomes permanently playable after the party decides to go after Lila in Mor Ardain.

If Rex is at low Affinity and is inflicted with any type of reaction while using Pyra, she will automatically switch to Mythra and she'll refuse to switch back to Pyra for approximately 13 seconds. She will also use the Absorb Damage Blade Art on doing so.
